# reduce
reduce keys_so_far
reduce add --from 0.:int=0
reduce add --from 0.:int=10 5
reduce add_members --from 0.:int=0
as files get .unit.files
reduce @files keys_so_far
reduce @files keys_so_far --from 0.0:str="first"
as none get .none
reduce @none keys_so_far
reduce @none add --from 0.:int=7
reduce answers_nothing
reduce add --from
as runner get .unit.runner
reduce @runner keys_so_far

# apply
apply @files transcript__arguments
apply @files transcript__arguments fixed --
as mixed arr 0.:int=1 0.:bool=true 0.:null 0.:str="x"
apply @mixed transcript__arguments
as empty arr
apply @empty transcript__arguments only
apply @files false
apply @files
apply transcript__arguments

# the indexed forms of structs: a callback receives the index as the key
each @files
map @files str_of_key
find @files key_is 1
find @files key_is 5
